scorecard.name: ExampleOrg SDR QA Scorecard — COPC-aligned
scorecard.overall_formula: weighted_avg(section.score) where section.score = avg(checkpoint.score_normalised) and checkpoint.score_normalised = checkpoint.score / 2 * 100

checkpoints.name: Login to Call Gap
checkpoints.description: Measures punctual start of productive calling after login.
checkpoints.metric: Minutes from agent login to first outbound/answered call (Five9 login & first-call timestamps).

checkpoints.name: Post-Call Logout Gap
checkpoints.description: Ensures agents do not remain idle long after last call.
checkpoints.metric: Minutes from last call end to agent logout (Five9 call-end & logout timestamps).

checkpoints.name: Calls Made vs Target
checkpoints.description: Checks productivity against planned daily/weekly call targets.
checkpoints.metric: Calls placed ÷ daily target × 100 (Five9 attempts vs target table).

checkpoints.name: Calls Answered %
checkpoints.description: Assesses list quality / dialing effectiveness via answer rate.
checkpoints.metric: Answered calls ÷ attempted calls × 100 (Five9 disposition summary).

checkpoints.name: Idle Time Ratio
checkpoints.description: Controls non-productive time while logged in.
checkpoints.metric: Total idle time ÷ login time × 100 (Five9 agent state logs).

checkpoints.name: Calls Logged in Real-Time
checkpoints.description: Validates timely CRM logging to maintain data integrity.
checkpoints.metric: % calls with matching CRM activity within 15 min of call end (Five9 ↔ CRM cross-check).

checkpoints.name: SLA Follow-up Compliance
checkpoints.description: Ensures first-contact SLA on new/assigned leads.
checkpoints.metric: % new/assigned leads first-contacted within 1 business day (CRM activities vs lead-creation date).

checkpoints.name: Process Stage Accuracy
checkpoints.description: Prevents stage skipping/misuse that breaks governance.
checkpoints.metric: % records following allowed next-stage transitions; no skips/misuse (CRM stage audit).

checkpoints.name: Communication Skills
checkpoints.description: Evaluates professionalism, clarity, and active listening.
checkpoints.metric: Rubric 0–2 assessing clarity, professionalism, active listening (gpt-4o-mini judge on transcript).

checkpoints.name: Objection Handling
checkpoints.description: Measures ability to probe and resolve objections.
checkpoints.metric: Rubric 0–2 on probing, reframing, and resolving/parking objections (ai_judge on transcript).

checkpoints.name: Call Flow & Structure
checkpoints.description: Evaluates adherence to recommended call flow.
checkpoints.metric: Rubric 0–2 on following intro → discovery → next-steps (ai_judge on transcript).

checkpoints.name: Tone & Sentiment
checkpoints.metric: Rubric 0–2 on positive, empathetic, confident tone (ai_judge + sentiment_score from call_analysis).

checkpoints.name: Action Plan Follow-up
checkpoints.description: Tracks completion of coaching action items.
checkpoints.metric: % coaching action items completed by due date (coaching_sessions.followup_due_date + completion flag).

checkpoints.name: Performance Improvement
checkpoints.metric: Δ total score vs 4-week rolling baseline (Coaching Effectiveness Index from Solution #5).

checkpoints.name: Conversion Ratio
checkpoints.description: Measures movement of leads to the next stage / meeting.
checkpoints.metric: % of leads moved to next stage / meeting (Zoho funnel).

checkpoints.name: Answer Rate
checkpoints.description: Measures call-list reachability and dialer effectiveness.

checkpoints.name: Utilization Ratio
checkpoints.description: Measures % of login time spent in talk state.
checkpoints.metric: Talk time ÷ login time × 100 (Five9 agent states).

checkpoints.name: Lead Volume Correlation
checkpoints.description: Validates alignment of activity with incoming lead volume.
checkpoints.metric: Pearson r between marketing lead volume and SDR activities, or qualitative pass.
